readme:
# ImageReward 排序学习与 ReFL 单步反馈

## 1. 问题

实现偏好排序损失，以及冻结前缀后的单步干净样本预测。

训练小型奖励评分器并通过冻结奖励函数更新单步噪声预测；不加载 BLIP 或图像解码器。

## 2. 核心公式

$$
L_{rank}=\operatorname{mean}\,\operatorname{softplus}(r_l-r_w),\qquad \hat x_0=(\operatorname{sg}(x_t)-\sigma_t\epsilon_\theta)/\alpha_t.
$$

## 3. 公式到代码

```python
ranking_loss(preferred: Tensor, rejected: Tensor) -> Tensor
```
```python
refl_clean(latent: Tensor, epsilon: Tensor, alpha: float, sigma: float) -> Tensor
```

对每对分数先求差，再用 softplus 保持大幅度输入下的稳定性。单步预测先冻结已有轨迹状态，再按噪声幅度恢复干净样本。奖励网络参数冻结不等于将奖励值 detach。

## 4. 本题约定

ranking_loss accepts equal (B,) preferred/rejected scores. refl_clean accepts equal (B,D) latent/epsilon, alpha and sigma are amplitude coefficients (not cumulative variances), alpha>0, sigma>=0.

Ranking differentiates both scores. ReFL stops the rollout latent and differentiates epsilon; the frozen reward model must still propagate gradients to its input.

## 5. 交互图与实验

实验使用你提交的函数。图中各点来自实际运行结果。

Eight scalar preference pairs train a linear reward scorer; 30 subsequent reward-gradient steps update a one-step epsilon model. This tests feedback mechanics, not image quality.

## 6. 在网页中运行

在右侧 Python 编辑器中补全实现，点击 **运行测试**。查看失败测试的原因、期望值与实际值，修改代码后再次运行。所有必要测试通过后，题目会标记为已完成并解锁坑点讲解。

## 7. 延伸

尝试保持奖励模型参数冻结，同时对图像解码器的输入反传。

[ImageReward: Learning and Evaluating Human Preferences for Text-to-Image Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2304.05977) · Section 2.2 Eq. (1); Section 3 Algorithm 1
notes:
# 题解与常见错误

对每对分数先求差，再用 softplus 保持大幅度输入下的稳定性。单步预测先冻结已有轨迹状态，再按噪声幅度恢复干净样本。奖励网络参数冻结不等于将奖励值 detach。

$$
L_{rank}=\operatorname{mean}\,\operatorname{softplus}(r_l-r_w),\qquad \hat x_0=(\operatorname{sg}(x_t)-\sigma_t\epsilon_\theta)/\alpha_t.
$$

Ranking differentiates both scores. ReFL stops the rollout latent and differentiates epsilon; the frozen reward model must still propagate gradients to its input.

不要把配对差值先平均再取 logistic；那会让相反偏好互相抵消。alpha 是振幅，不能再开平方。冻结 latent 能切断前缀梯度，epsilon 的梯度应为 -sigma/alpha。

测试依据：独立标量 logistic、极端分数、反解恒等式和解析梯度；T3 先训练奖励评分器再优化生成参数。

## 实验标定

固定种子 42，CPU float64，直接梯度下降；无需数据下载。以下是参考解实际测量，不是预设轨迹。 PyTorch 2.14.1. ranking lr=.3 (40 updates); generator lr=.03 (30 updates).

```json
{"final": 0.089454537799872, "initial": 0.6931471805599453, "reward_gain": 1.9853489655118983}
```

验收阈值见 `tests/test_core.py::test_real_toy_experiment`；基线为训练前参数的实际输出。

en.readme:
# ImageReward Ranking and ReFL One-Step Feedback

## 1. Problem

Implement pairwise reward ranking and one-step clean prediction from a frozen rollout prefix.

Train a small reward scorer and update an epsilon predictor through a fixed differentiable reward; no BLIP or image decoder.

## 2. Core equations

$$
L_{rank}=\operatorname{mean}\,\operatorname{softplus}(r_l-r_w),\qquad \hat x_0=(\operatorname{sg}(x_t)-\sigma_t\epsilon_\theta)/\alpha_t.
$$

## 3. From equations to code

```python
ranking_loss(preferred: Tensor, rejected: Tensor) -> Tensor
```
```python
refl_clean(latent: Tensor, epsilon: Tensor, alpha: float, sigma: float) -> Tensor
```

Form a rejected-minus-preferred score margin and apply stable softplus. Detach the already sampled latent before solving the noising equation for the clean sample. Freezing reward parameters must preserve the derivative with respect to its input.

## 4. Contract

ranking_loss accepts equal (B,) preferred/rejected scores. refl_clean accepts equal (B,D) latent/epsilon, alpha and sigma are amplitude coefficients (not cumulative variances), alpha>0, sigma>=0.

Ranking differentiates both scores. ReFL stops the rollout latent and differentiates epsilon; the frozen reward model must still propagate gradients to its input.

## 5. Visualization and experiment

The experiment calls your submitted functions; plotted points are measured results.

Eight scalar preference pairs train a linear reward scorer; 30 subsequent reward-gradient steps update a one-step epsilon model. This tests feedback mechanics, not image quality.

## 6. Run your implementation

Complete the functions in the Python editor on the right, then click **Run tests**. Inspect each failed check, update your implementation, and run again. Passing every required check marks the problem as solved and unlocks the notes.

## 7. Extensions

Extend the exercise to a differentiable decoder while keeping reward parameters fixed.

[ImageReward: Learning and Evaluating Human Preferences for Text-to-Image Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2304.05977) · Section 2.2 Eq. (1); Section 3 Algorithm 1
en.notes:
# Solution reasoning and pitfalls

Form a rejected-minus-preferred score margin and apply stable softplus. Detach the already sampled latent before solving the noising equation for the clean sample. Freezing reward parameters must preserve the derivative with respect to its input.

$$
L_{rank}=\operatorname{mean}\,\operatorname{softplus}(r_l-r_w),\qquad \hat x_0=(\operatorname{sg}(x_t)-\sigma_t\epsilon_\theta)/\alpha_t.
$$

Ranking differentiates both scores. ReFL stops the rollout latent and differentiates epsilon; the frozen reward model must still propagate gradients to its input.

Averaging margins before logistic would cancel opposing preferences. Alpha is an amplitude, so do not take another square root. The latent has no gradient and the epsilon derivative is -sigma/alpha.

Test basis: Scalar logistic oracle, extreme scores, noising inversion and analytic gradients; T3 trains a scorer then optimizes a generator parameter.

## Experiment calibration

Seed 42, CPU float64, direct gradient descent, no downloaded data. Values below were measured from the reference, not a preset trajectory. PyTorch 2.14.1. ranking lr=.3 (40 updates); generator lr=.03 (30 updates).

```json
{"final": 0.089454537799872, "initial": 0.6931471805599453, "reward_gain": 1.9853489655118983}
```

Acceptance thresholds are in `tests/test_core.py::test_real_toy_experiment`; the baseline is the measured output before training.
